cards.question: TikTok Name Generator
cards.qualifier: Type your niche or nickname, pick a style, and get 30 TikTok username ideas that fit the app's character rules and are easy to say in a video.

cards.name: what-makes-a-good
cards.title: What makes a good TikTok username

groups.label: It's readable in a split second
groups.text: Your username shows on the For You feed.

groups.label: It sounds right when you say it
groups.text: Many creators sign off with "follow @..." in their videos.

groups.label: It looks good as a watermark
groups.text: When people save a TikTok, the downloaded video carries your @username.
